verification_note: goal NAME { deps } + pursue NAME plans a path via the SAME uniform-cost search as plan() (a real 3-step plan found for a goal with no single satisfying action); activate PLAN runs each bound closure (action_bind) in order and returns true only if ALL succeed; re-binding an action to a closure that now returns false, then re-pursuing and re-activating, correctly fails on the SECOND attempt -- confirming a plan being FOUND (a dependency graph being satisfiable) is a genuinely different claim from activating it SUCCEEDING (the bound closures actually running to completion)
